why: batch 51, test 51.4 (jobs/c3/batch51.yaml; Q51.4): the swap at the last token; sealed
question: no prediction: coverage run on an already-scored rule
items_rule: x8_write.eligible's gate and eligibility on the routes generator's C0 scenes (O; gate 0.8 per reader on O's read accuracy; the first 300 eligible)
site: the last token = the read position of X0's chat read (the digit's space token appended to O)

arms.bridge_swap: s (mu_k - mu_j) added at the last token at the layer; mu = x0_massmean.pointer_means (fit at the bridge word at L on the probe run's scenes; not refit, the same at L + 4)
arms.bridge_random: a Gaussian vector of bridge_swap's norm (one per item, k, layer, s; seed 4401)
arms.last_swap: s (mu'_k - mu'_j), mu' = class means by j of the lookup's last-token states at that layer over the fit half; read half only
arms.last_random: a Gaussian vector of last_swap's norm (same stream)

split: bridge entities sorted, shuffled with random.Random(0), first half fit (x49_attn.split_halves)
probe: x0_probe.cv_predict on the lookup's last-token states per layer (one-hot ridge, 5 outer folds holding out whole bridge entities, inner 4-fold penalty); majority baseline (training folds); chance 1/3
rule: "The code travels": the bridge-fit swap sends >= 0.3 of lookups to slot k (random <= 0.05). "Re-encoded on copy": bridge-fit <= 0.10 while last-token-fit >= 0.3. "Not at the last token": both <= 0.10 while the probe reads the slot there >= 0.8. Otherwise in between
as_computed: over the four cells (layer L or L + 4, s = 1 or 2): travels if some cell has bridge_swap's target share >= 0.30 and its own bridge_random's <= 0.05; else re-encoded if every cell's bridge_swap <= 0.10 and some cell's last_swap >= 0.30; else not at the last token if every cell's bridge_swap and last_swap <= 0.10 and the probe's held-out accuracy at the last token at L or L + 4 >= 0.80; else in between. bridge_swap / bridge_random over every item, last_swap / last_random over the read half
